purpose: Discover candidate relations that can inform Observation and Workflow design; not acceptance testing.

boundary.cached_outcomes: exposed R4D-A/B only; each served UID averaged over its available windows

definitions.raw_features: linear interpolation; robust center/scale per historical context; standard-library descriptors
definitions.historical_seasonal_error: MAE of repeating last 24 context points over observed historical targets, divided by context robust scale
definitions.positive_outcomes: positive means pc better, processing helps, or W2 beats MAD; magnitude is unsigned
definitions.uncertainty: same-data descriptive search; correlated windows; only four shared training cohorts; zero formal significance claims
